## Summary
<!-- One or two sentences: what does this change do, and why? -->

## Linked issues
<!-- e.g. "Closes #123", "Fixes #456" -->

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Refactor / chore (`refactor:` / `chore:`)
- [ ] CI / build (`ci:` / `build:`)
- [ ] Breaking change

## Test plan
<!-- What did you run to verify the change? Commands, screenshots, logs. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: …`, `fix(scope): …`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit, API, interface or browser, as fits)
- [ ] The OpenAPI snapshot and the generated client are refreshed, if the API changed
- [ ] New texts of the web interface have a German translation
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG are updated where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or `.env` files are committed
- [ ] I have read my own diff
